item.title: You've got Soul
item.description: Imagine a presence so pure that merely coming close to it brings you to tears of awe.

item.title: Spirituality = better parent
item.description: Recognizing that we are part of something bigger than ourselves and that our actions account for only about 80% of the outcome, with 20% firmly outside of our control, allows us to take our fears less seriously.

item.title: Self-Love Principles (Affirmations)
item.description: We tend to live life in the lofty realm of the mind. Society encourages this through an emphasis on comparison, achievement, and milestones.

item.title: What the life journey feels like
item.description: Imagine walking with a lantern through an enchanted forest. Every trinket, every leaf of grass, every breath of air is magical.

item.title: Self-Love Principles (Food)
item.description: Principles to eat by: Food has a purpose. Beyond that purpose (eating too much) its value quickly diminishes to the point of becoming toxic, addictive, or burdensome.

item.title: The value of argument
item.description: Imagine a thunderstorm. Lighting bolts illuminating the dark clouds. Booming thunder restoring perspective. Rain washing away the debris.

item.title: Supermarket Society
item.description: I was talking to a friend today. Her words made me think of a surprising metaphor.

item.title: Presence
item.description: What comes to mind when you see or hear the word presence? Is it related to the mind?

item.title: The expert
item.description: A coaching session is said to have no expert. I tend to disagree with this principle.

item.title: What is coaching?
item.description: During a 1-on-1 coaching session we create a safe space for sharing thoughts, feelings, and emotions.
